title: Temporary report writers can clobber foreign files through symlinked roots or report leaves
title_de: Temporäre Report-Writer können fremde Dateien über symlinkte Wurzeln oder Report-Leaves überschreiben
summary: Predictable temporary report roots and pathname-based report/index/log/cleanup writes allowed a pre-created symlink to redirect a report writer into a foreign path.
summary_de: Vorhersehbare temporäre Report-Wurzeln und pfadbasierte Report-/Index-/Log-/Cleanup-Writes erlaubten einem vorangelegten Symlink, einen Report-Writer in einen fremden Pfad umzuleiten.
observed_behavior: Before the fix, a real TMP_ROOT/modsecurity-doc-cleanup directory symlink made generate-connector-roadmap.py overwrite an external sentinel and return 0.
observed_behavior_de: Vor dem Fix ließ ein echter TMP_ROOT/modsecurity-doc-cleanup-Verzeichnis-Symlink generate-connector-roadmap.py einen externen Sentinel überschreiben und Return Code 0 liefern.
expected_behavior: Temporary report output uses a random private root and descriptor-bound canonical write authority; parent/final symlinks, foreign files, unsafe children, and cleanup substitutions are rejected or unlinked only as a leaf.
expected_behavior_de: Temporäre Report-Ausgabe verwendet eine zufällige private Wurzel und deskriptorgebundene kanonische Schreibautorität; Parent-/Final-Symlinks, Fremddateien, unsichere Children und Cleanup-Substitutionen werden abgewiesen oder nur als Leaf unlinked.
impact: A local attacker could overwrite or corrupt arbitrary same-user files reachable through a report temporary-root or final-leaf symlink, including documentation/evidence publication targets.
impact_de: Ein lokaler Angreifer konnte beliebige über einen Report-Temp-Root- oder Final-Leaf-Symlink erreichbare Same-User-Dateien überschreiben oder korrumpieren, einschließlich Dokumentations-/Evidence-Publikationszielen.
preconditions: The attacker can prepare a directory or leaf symlink under a report temporary/output ancestor.
A report generator or refresh publisher executes its legacy pathname write or cleanup path.
reproduction: Create TMP_ROOT/modsecurity-doc-cleanup as a directory symlink to a directory containing a sentinel.
Run the roadmap/report publisher and observe the sentinel overwrite before the fix.
Repeat with parent/final symlinks and a validation-to-publish swap.

evidence.command: rtk env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-run>/tmp /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_report_temp_path_findings_poc

root_cause: The report publisher treated lexical Path objects and a predictable temporary directory as write authority. It did not bind writes/cleanup to directory FDs, distinguish trusted reads from writes, enforce final-leaf no-follow/exclusive publication, or limit README/legacy cleanup names.
root_cause_de: Der Report-Publisher behandelte lexikalische Path-Objekte und ein vorhersehbares temporäres Verzeichnis als Schreibautorität. Er band Writes/Cleanup nicht an Verzeichnis-FDs, unterschied vertrauenswürdige Reads nicht von Writes, erzwingte kein Final-Leaf-No-Follow/exklusive Publikation und begrenzte README-/Legacy-Cleanup-Namen nicht.
proposed_remediation: PR B introduces separate canonical read/write report authorities, descriptor-relative lstat/no-follow traversal, atomic allowlisted publication, CSPRNG private temporary roots, strict child validation, and symlink-leaf-only cleanup.
proposed_remediation_de: PR B führt getrennte kanonische Read-/Write-Report-Autoritäten, deskriptorrelative lstat/No-Follow-Traversierung, atomare allowlistete Publikation, CSPRNG-private temporäre Wurzeln, strikte Child-Validierung und Symlink-Leaf-only-Cleanup ein.
acceptance_criteria: The original legacy temporary-root symlink and parent/final/swap variants do not change foreign sentinels.
Unsafe child forms and foreign files are rejected; parallel private allocation and legitimate controlled publication succeed.
Only allowlisted README leaves and registered generated reports may be written or removed.
validation_plan: Run the retained pre-fix/post-fix symlink PoC and 18 focused report-path controls on the exact PR head.
Compile changed Python source in memory and review direct writer/cleanup sinks.
Verify exact delivery PR head and record Framework-dependent full refresh as a gap if unavailable.
dependencies: FND-PARENT-0033 provides the verified runtime-root capability used when runtime generator logs are present.
blocked_by: Framework-backed full refresh/layout validation is blocked_missing_evidence.
deduplication_note: Distinct from FND-PARENT-0033 because report publication has its own canonical write authority and direct report/index/cleanup sinks; distinct from FND-PARENT-0035 because no Library rule parser is involved.
residual_risk: The demonstrated Parent report boundary is fixed locally but delivery-pending until remote exact-head CI/review. Framework-backed full refresh is not a passing result and is retained as an evidence gap.
residual_risk_de: Die demonstrierte Parent-Report-Grenze ist lokal fixed, aber delivery-pending bis zu Remote-Exact-Head-CI/Review. Framework-gestützter Full Refresh ist kein bestandenes Ergebnis und bleibt eine Evidenzlücke.

history.detail: The real legacy symlink clobber was reproduced before the fix; exact-head focused controls passed after descriptor-bound remediation.
